question: Which treasure and accompanying figure are placed on the right and left in this worship?
premises: Śaṅkha-nidhi is placed on the right.
On the left is one joined with Vasumatī.
The placement is part of the ritual arrangement.
inference: Śaṅkha-nidhi should be placed on the right and the one joined with Vasumatī on the left.
uncertainties: The identity of the figure joined with Vasumatī is not explicitly named.
plain_english: On the right the conch treasure, and on the left the one joined with Vasumatī.
